accepted_limitations: This is a source-only review. It grants no execution, retry, resume, refill, overwrite, training, scientific-claim, navigation, promotion, deployment, calibration, bounded-experiment, or successor authority.

The reviewed experiment is an exact deterministic implementation-equivalence check over one ordinary TRAIN scene per family and the first four bound historical poses per scene: 8 scenes, 32 historical frames, 32 candidate renders, and 32 duplicate renders. It is not a statistical estimate and establishes no out-of-panel, held-out, real-robot, or navigation generalization.

The candidate path deliberately reuses the frozen historical render_replay_v03 scene builder, texture machinery, and camera-pose helper. A pass therefore establishes exact wiring and implementation equivalence at the 32 bound inputs, not agreement between independent rendering engines or realism of the textured-v03 domain.

The parity attempt performs zero physics steps, zero auxiliary depth renders, no model loading for inference, no model training, and no planning evaluation. Its output cannot by itself establish world-model usefulness.

The official source panel and exact plan are immutable caller-bound documents generated after the source freeze, not members of commit 7d5b6c53891dd079da6452aa7e5b18a656cfd3af. This review verifies their exact current SHA-256 and byte-count bindings; a later explicit authority must bind the plan and this review separately before execution.

The runtime contract binds the selected Python executable target, environment config, graphics tools, robot URDF, policy artifacts, registries, and platform manifest, but does not recursively hash-close all installed third-party package contents. Exact source/candidate and candidate/duplicate decoded-pixel equality remains the terminal scientific gate for this bounded parity check.

Graphics-device availability and live GPU state are external preflight conditions, not findings minted by this source-only review. They must still pass under the exact scrubbed execution environment before the one-shot attempt root is created.

The attempt root was absent at review time. If later authority is issued, atomic creation of that root consumes the single attempt even if failure occurs before the reservation document is written; no retry, resume, refill, or overwrite is permitted.

A successful supervisor terminal remains COMPLETE_PENDING_TERMINAL_REVIEW. The parity result, consumed successful terminal, and independent terminal review must all be deeply revalidated as one exact triple before V3 calibration may consume the parity prerequisite.
